regions.region: left-column graphical abstract reaction arrow beneath title
regions.finding: Generic 2,3-allenoate to 3-phenylseleno-4-oxo-2(E)-alkenoate transformation; retained as a general scheme with PhSeCl/Li2CO3, MeCN, r.t., 1 h, and the reported 63-93% range rather than as an extra experiment.
Present-paper preliminary 1a + 2.0 equiv PhSeCl in MeCN experiment affording 2a (55%) and 3a (17%); missing time, temperature, atmosphere, scale, and yield basis preserved.
Prior-literature aqueous MeCN example giving 3a in 100%; classified as literature_example, not as a new experiment from this paper.
Background and cited prior work were inspected; no additional row- or arrow-level experiment was created from narrative citations.

unresolved: The generic R1/R2 structures and the graphical-abstract yield basis are not fully specified.
Scheme 1 omits several conditions and yield measurement bases.

regions.region: Table 1 including reaction arrow, 13 rows, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Thirteen distinct temperature/concentration/atmosphere optimization experiments extracted; H2O footnote additions and NMR-yield exceptions were structured row by row.

regions.region: Table 2 including reaction arrow, 9 rows, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Nine distinct additive/PhSeCl optimization experiments extracted; the 2.5-equiv Li2CO3 override in entry 9 and NMR measurement basis were preserved.

regions.region: Table 3 including scope arrow, 12 rows, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Twelve substrate-scope experiments extracted separately. Entry-specific 48 h and 3.0-equiv PhSeCl overrides were applied; overlapping-NMR ratio failures remain missing rather than guessed.
Distinct 1m to 3m lactonization recorded at 88% isolated yield; uncertain spiro structure connectivity was not forced into SMILES.

regions.region: body prose around Tables 1-3 and start of control-experiment discussion
regions.finding: Narrative comparisons and the less-than-4% butenolide statement were linked to their table records. The cross-page control-experiment sentence was completed from page 3 and recorded there.

unresolved: Several scope structures are represented only by unverified connectivity candidates; E geometry is not encoded.
Table 3 entries 2, 4, and 5 have no numerical 2:3 ratio because the source reports overlapping 1H NMR signals.
Optimization and most scope rows omit detailed workup/purification information.

regions.region: Table 4 including reaction arrow, 7 water-equivalent rows, and footnote a
regions.finding: Seven distinct water-effect optimization experiments extracted, including the explicit zero-water row and zero-percent 2a result at 111 equiv H2O.
Proposed branched mechanism through intermediates 4-7 recorded as mechanism, not as isolated experimental stages; the role of water remains unresolved in the source.

regions.region: left-column opening prose continuing the three control experiments
regions.finding: Three separate negative controls involving 3a/PhSeCl, added EtOH, and EtOH/HCl were retained as no-reaction records with missing time/temperature left explicit.

Detailed quantities, addition order, 1 h room-temperature reaction, silica filtration, NMR analysis, chromatography, 53.1 mg and 77% isolated result were merged into Table 3 entry 1 rather than duplicated.

regions.region: analytical data, acknowledgments, Supporting Information Available notice, and references
regions.finding: Analytical characterization was inspected as support for 2a identity but not converted into a separate reaction. The SI notice does not establish an attached SI document, so no association was made.

unresolved: Control-experiment times, temperatures, and some reagent amounts are absent.
The authors explicitly state that the real role of H2O remains under study.
The paper announces SI availability, but no SI was provided or associated in this workspace.
